field_principles.beats_position_only_baseline: BARE bool: true iff the A1 localizer beats a content-blind position-only baseline on the REAL split (CI95-excl-0) -- rules out the 'localizer just learned where errors sit' artifact.
field_principles.held_out_real_localization_delta_ci95: Bootstrap CI95 of the localization delta on a HELD-OUT REAL split -- excluding 0 rules out synthetic-distribution / single-split overfit.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. A genuine PASS (the localizer headline graduates) and a FAIL (the A1 win quarantined as template-leak/position/overfit-confounded) are BOTH decision-grade.
field_principles.localizer_win_is_genuine: BARE bool: the capstone reads this; true iff the A1 real-split advantage beats a content-blind position-only baseline AND degrades under template-ablation AND holds on a held-out REAL split (all CI95-excl-0) -- the diagnostic that the localizer win is real first-error structure, not synthetic-template leakage / position bias / overfit.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records the A1 win + corpus + REAL split + TRM-stand-down verified; pre-empts the silent-missing-resource fabrication mode.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition for the template-ablation + the position-only baseline + the held-out split + the bootstrap.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the A1 localizer + the ablations + the held-out split; lets a third party re-run.
field_principles.template_ablation_drop: BARE float: the REAL-split F1 drop when the synthetic injection template is shuffled/randomized -- a material drop confirms the localizer learned real first-error structure, not the template; ~0 drop = template leakage.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: BARE bool=false -- the localizer is oracle-distinct.

methodology_note: The diagnostic uses the Exp 4392 A1 localizer as the model under test, reconstructs the deterministic synthetic corpus for the template-ablation retrain, and evaluates only cached REAL FoVer traces. No TRM training or live generation is invoked.

missing_verifier_gaps.candidate_design: Collect or construct REAL first-error traces with varied first-error positions and retrain the localizer with template-family holdouts.
missing_verifier_gaps.missing_discriminator: A held-out real split with non-degenerate first-error positions.
